description: Re-pinned after splitting AnalyticsLegacy.tsx (2,614 lines) into a shell, a hook and five section panels. No string was added: total actionable text FELL 12,441 -> 12,423. The i18n policy classifies by PATH, so literals that counted as other-client inside a monolith named AnalyticsLegacy.tsx move once the panels carry accurate names — SalesSectionPanel matches "sales", ContainersSectionPanel matches "container". sales-pos and container-purchasing rise for that reason alone and other-client falls to match. reports-exports would have gone 0 -> 3 on the same mechanism; rather than weaken that zero invariant or rename a panel to dodge the classifier, the three literals ("Particulars" twice and "Adjust your filters and try again") were translated into client/src/i18n/sharedUiPhase3Translations.part6.ts, which is why the overall total falls. Re-pinned after merging origin/main (52 commits) into the quality branch. The single additional actionable literal is factory-module text introduced on main, not by this branch; every other module is unchanged from the post-split baseline. Re-pinned after the Phase 4 god-file split of FactoryPayrollTab, DailyProductionReport, FactoryBaleProductHistory and workerStatsAdvancesRoutes. No untranslated string was added: total actionable text FELL from 12,468 to 12,440. The accounting module rises 1,351 -> 1,368 purely because the bale-ledger tab panel now lives in a file whose path contains "ledger", which config/i18n-audit-policy.json classifies as accounting — the same rule that already classified the LedgerSection component beside it. Factory falls 5,409 -> 5,386 and inventory-logistics 1,488 -> 1,474 for the same reason, so the accounting rise is a reclassification and is more than offset. Detector and policy digest are unchanged and unclassified findings remain at zero.
